em_analise.EXPLICACAO_SEM_DATA: It usually takes minutes, but it can take up to 24 hours. The status shows up here.

pausado.EXPLICACAO: Many people blocked the number or marked the message as unwanted. WhatsApp paused it {quando}: the 1st pause lasts 3 hours and the 2nd, 6 hours. The 3rd time, it disables the template.
pausado.DICA: send only to people who know your business and say who is talking right at the start.
pausado.EXPLICACAO_SEM_DATA: Many people blocked the number or marked the message as unwanted. The 1st pause lasts 3 hours and the 2nd, 6 hours. The 3rd time, WhatsApp disables the template.

desativado.EXPLICACAO: After repeated pauses for blocks and reports, WhatsApp disabled this template. It does not come back on its own and cannot be changed.
desativado.DICA: duplicate the template, rewrite the text saying right at the start who is talking, and send it only to people who know your business.

limite.TITULO: Not created: the WhatsApp account reached its template limit
limite.EXPLICACAO: WhatsApp did not create this template because the account already has the most templates it can have.
limite.DICA: delete the templates you no longer use and create this one again. If you need more templates, verify your business with Meta: verified accounts can have more.

campo_no_fim.TITULO: The message ends with a field
campo_no_fim.EXPLICACAO: The last thing in the text is a field. WhatsApp asks for a sentence after it.
campo_no_fim.COMO_RESOLVER: write a short sentence at the end, for example: “Any questions, just reply.”

campo_no_inicio.TITULO: The message starts with a field
campo_no_inicio.EXPLICACAO: The text starts right away with a field. WhatsApp asks for a word before it.
campo_no_inicio.COMO_RESOLVER: start with a greeting, for example: “Hello,”.

exemplo_faltando.TITULO: A field is missing its example
exemplo_faltando.EXPLICACAO: WhatsApp needs an example for each field to understand the message.
exemplo_faltando.COMO_RESOLVER: fill in the example of every field.

parece_divulgacao.EXPLICACAO: The template was sent as a notice, but the text talks about an offer.
parece_divulgacao.COMO_RESOLVER: take the offer out of the text or create a promotion template.

outro.COMO_RESOLVER: make the text simpler and clearer and send it again.

formato_invalido.TITULO: The text is not in the format WhatsApp accepts
formato_invalido.EXPLICACAO: WhatsApp found a problem with the shape of the message: fields, buttons or size.
formato_invalido.COMO_RESOLVER: check the fields and buttons, keep the text short and send it again.

conteudo_proibido.TITULO: WhatsApp does not allow this content
conteudo_proibido.EXPLICACAO: WhatsApp considered the text offensive or misleading.
conteudo_proibido.COMO_RESOLVER: rewrite it clearly, saying who is talking and why, and send it again.

botao_copiar_codigo.TITULO: The “Copy code” button has no code
botao_copiar_codigo.EXPLICACAO: WhatsApp asks for an example code in this button, and the button only exists in promotion messages.
botao_copiar_codigo.COMO_RESOLVER: if it is a notice, such as a payment reminder, remove the button and send the copy of the bill in the conversation; if it is a promotion, write an example code such as PROMO10.

FORMATOS.TEXTO: For when a regular message is not enough.

boas_vindas.TEXTO: Hello, [nome_cliente]! This is [nome_empresa]. Glad to have you with us. Whenever you need anything, just send us a message here.

lembrete.PARA: To remind the customer of the booked time.
lembrete.TEXTO: Hello, [nome_cliente]! A reminder of your appointment at [nome_empresa]: on [data], at [horario]. Do you confirm? Tap one of the options below.

pesquisa.PARA: To learn how a service that already happened went.
pesquisa.TEXTO: Hello, [nome_cliente]! You were served by [nome_empresa] on [data]. How was it? Tap one of the options below.

promocao.PARA: To tell about an offer with a deadline.
promocao.TEXTO: Hi, [nome_cliente]! Until [data], you get [desconto] off at [nome_empresa]. Want to take it? See the offers in the button below.

cobranca.PARA: To remind the customer of a payment that is coming due.
cobranca.TEXTO: Hello, [nome_cliente]. A reminder from [nome_empresa]: the payment of [valor] is due on [data]. If you have already paid, please disregard. If you need a copy of the bill, tap the button below.

retomar.PARA: To talk again to someone who went quiet.
retomar.TEXTO: Hi, [nome_cliente]! This is [nome_empresa]. Any questions left from our last conversation? Just reply here and we will pick it up.

renovacao.PARA: To let them know the contract is about to expire and needs renewing.
renovacao.TEXTO: Hello, [nome_cliente]. A notice from [nome_empresa]: your contract expires on [data]. Do you want to renew? Tap one of the options below.

andamento.PARA: To tell the customer their order has moved forward.
andamento.TEXTO: Hello, [nome_cliente]. An update from [nome_empresa]: your order has moved forward. Want to know the details? Tap the button below.

IA.OBJETIVO: What does the message need to do?
IA.OBJETIVO_EXEMPLO: E.g.: remind the customer of tomorrow’s appointment
IA.ERRO: I couldn’t write it now. Try again or write it your own way.
IA.DIVULGACAO_CUSTA: This is promotion: it costs {divulgacao} per message, against {aviso} for a service notice.

PEDIDOS.manter_aviso: Keep it as a service notice (cheaper)

IA.NAO_DA_AVISO: This text offers something to the customer, so WhatsApp treats it as promotion. To be a service notice, it must only talk about something the customer already asked for or already has with you.
IA.CORTE: The text is {n}% shorter, without counting the fields.

horario.link_codigo: Code of the link to manage the appointment

FRANQUIA.EXPLICA: WhatsApp gives {limite} free replies per number each month. After that, each reply costs {valor}.
FRANQUIA.EXPLICA_SEM_VALOR: WhatsApp gives {limite} free replies per number each month.
FRANQUIA.ESTIMATIVA: Estimate: it counts only the replies sent through Chat2You. Replies sent from another app on the same number are not included. The month resets at midnight in the WhatsApp account time zone.

JANELA.TITULO: Who talked to you in the last 24 hours
JANELA.NINGUEM: No one in this audience talked to you in the last 24 hours. Everyone gets the template.
JANELA.DENTRO: {n} person talked to you | {n} people talked to you
JANELA.DENTRO_PODE: Can get a message written by you, without a template.
JANELA.FORA: {n} person did not talk to you | {n} people did not talk to you
JANELA.FORA_SEM_MODELO: Choose a template above for the people who did not talk to you.
JANELA.ECONOMIA: Writing to them saves you about {valor}.
JANELA.ESCREVER: Write to {n} person | Write to {n} people
JANELA.CONFERIMOS: We check again when sending. Anyone who has not talked to you in the last 24 hours gets the template.

GAVETA.TITULO: Message for {n} person | Message for {n} people
GAVETA.O_QUE: What do you want to say?
GAVETA.O_QUE_EXEMPLO: E.g.: let them know the new collection arrived and they can reserve by replying
GAVETA.ERRO: I could not write it now. Try again or write it your way.
GAVETA.ESCOLHA: Pick the one that suits you best. You can change it later.
GAVETA.LINK_DIGITADO: Links cannot be typed in the text. Use the field button (e.g. the offer link, from the audience).
GAVETA.PARECE_LINK: This looks like a link. For links, use the field button (e.g. the offer link).
GAVETA.LONGO: The message is over {max} characters. Make it shorter.

REVISAO.TEXTO: {n} person gets your message | {n} people get your message
REVISAO.MODELO: {n} person gets the template “{nome}” ({preco} each) | {n} people get the template “{nome}” ({preco} each)
REVISAO.ECONOMIZOU: You save {valor} by writing to the people who talked to you.
REVISAO.ESTIMATIVA: This is an estimate: when sending we check again who talked to you in the last 24 hours.
REVISAO.CONTEUDO_TEXTO: People who talked to you in the last 24 hours get: “{texto}”

CUSTO_ESCRITA.passa: {gratis} go out free (about {sobram} left of this month's {limite}); the other {pagas} cost {preco} each: {valor}.
CUSTO_ESCRITA.sem_franquia: We could not read this month's free messages: count on up to {valor} ({preco} each).

JANELA.CANAL_HINT: Template approved by Meta. People who talked to you in the last 24 hours can get a message written by you.
JANELA.AVISO_PROPAGANDA: Too much advertising can get the number blocked. Write something useful for the person.
JANELA.FALHOU: We could not check who talked to you right now.
JANELA.TEXTO_DESCARTADO: This template has a coupon, a limited-time offer or a carousel. Everyone gets the full template, so the message you wrote was removed.

bom.TEXTO: Almost nobody blocked or reported this message. Keep sending it to people who know your business.

atencao.TITULO: Attention: some people did not like it
atencao.TEXTO: WhatsApp saw blocks, reports or few people reading. If it gets worse, WhatsApp pauses this template and the campaigns using it stop.

ruim.TITULO: May be paused: many people are blocking
ruim.TEXTO: Many people blocked the number, reported it or did not read it. WhatsApp can pause this template at any time: 3 hours the 1st time, 6 hours the 2nd, and the 3rd time it disables it.

sem_nota.TEXTO: WhatsApp rates a template after people receive it and react. Every new template starts like this.

DICAS.QUEM: Send it only to customers or to people who asked to receive it.
DICAS.COMECO: Say right at the start who is writing and why.
DICAS.MENOS: Send it less often to the same person.

SAUDE.SEM_ENVIOS: This template was not sent in the last 30 days. The numbers show up after the first send.
SAUDE.NOTA: We only count what was sent through Chat2You, and the spend is estimated from the WhatsApp price table. Not everyone lets WhatsApp show they read it, so more people may have read it.

um.PARA: Big photo, name and price of one product.

varios.PARA: Up to 30 products. The customer taps and sees the list.

carrossel.PARA: 2 to 10 products the customer swipes through.

PRODUTOS_NO_MODELO.TITULO_AJUDA: Shows above the message. Up to {n} characters.
PRODUTOS_NO_MODELO.TITULO_ERRO: Write a title of up to {n} characters.
PRODUTOS_NO_MODELO.ESCOLHE_NA_CAMPANHA: You choose the products when you create the campaign, so the same template works for many offers.

AUTORIZACAO.AVISO: You allow {marca} to create templates on its own. The templates you already have stay as they are.

SERVICO.EXPLICA: Updates about a customer order or service, such as confirmations, reminders and payment notices.

DIVULGACAO.EXPLICA: Offers, promotions and invitations for the customer to buy again.
DIVULGACAO.TRAVADA: Check Service notice to unlock this one.

META.COBRA: Meta charges for every delivered message, even while the conversation is open.
META.TABELA: Prices from Meta’s rate card for Brazil, in effect since {data}.
META.LIMITE_MODELOS: Each WhatsApp account accepts up to {modelos} templates ({verificada} if the business is verified by Meta) and up to {porHora} new ones per hour.
META.LIMITE_DIVULGACAO: Meta limits how many promotions each person receives. Some may not be delivered.

AUTORIZACAO.LIGADA_POR: Turned on by {nome} on {dia} at {hora}, in the account time zone ({fuso}).
AUTORIZACAO.LIGADA_POR_SEM_FUSO: Turned on by {nome} on {dia} at {hora}, in your account time zone.
AUTORIZACAO.DESLIGADA_POR: Turned off by {nome} on {dia} at {hora}, in the account time zone ({fuso}).
AUTORIZACAO.DESLIGADA_POR_SEM_FUSO: Turned off by {nome} on {dia} at {hora}, in your account time zone.
AUTORIZACAO.ALGUEM: someone no longer in the account
AUTORIZACAO.FALHOU: That did not work. Please try again.

RESUMO.DESLIGADA: Off. {marca} does not create templates on its own.
RESUMO.LIGADA_TUDO: On for Service notice and Promotion.

AUTORIZACAO.SO_ADMIN: Only account administrators, or roles with Finance in Edit, can change this.

CONVERSA.ERRO_GERAL: Could not send right now. Try again in a moment.
CONVERSA.ESGOTADO: “{nome}” sold out in the catalog. Swap the product to send. | These products sold out in the catalog: {nome}. Swap them to send.

CARTAO.AJUDA: Pick the photo for this card and complete the text.
CARTAO.FOTO_AJUDA: Use a photo from the template or upload one from your computer.
CARTAO.FOTO_AJUDA_GALERIA: Use one of the template photos.
CARTAO.GALERIA_FALHOU: Could not load the template photos. Close and open the template again.
CARTAO.SEM_GALERIA: This template has no saved photos. Ask whoever manages the templates to send it, or pick another template.
CARTAO.ERRO_TIPO: This file is not a photo. Pick a JPG or PNG photo.
CARTAO.ERRO_GRANDE: This photo is {tamanho} MB, and WhatsApp accepts up to 5 MB. Make the photo smaller (saving it again at a smaller size works) or use a template photo.
CARTAO.ERRO_ENVIO: Could not upload the photo. Try again.

AJUDA.um: See how the customer will get it. If it looks right, just send.
AJUDA.varios: See how the customer will get it. The list order is the order the customer sees.
AJUDA.carrossel: See how the customer will get it. The cards follow the order of the list.
AJUDA.cartoes: See all the cards. If it looks right, just send.

PRODUTOS.ACABOU: Sold out in the catalog. Swap it for another.

SEM_CATALOGO.TITULO: This WhatsApp has no product catalog
SEM_CATALOGO.AJUDA: Without a catalog, this template cannot be sent.
SEM_CATALOGO.TEXTO: This template shows catalog products, but no catalog is linked to this WhatsApp number.
SEM_CATALOGO.PASSO_2: Link the store catalog to the WhatsApp account of this number.
SEM_CATALOGO.PASSO_3: Come back and pick the template again.

CONVERSA.VALIDADE: The offer is valid until (account time zone: {zona})
CONVERSA.VALIDADE_AJUDA: The customer sees a countdown until this time.
CONVERSA.VALIDADE_SEM_FUSO: This account has no time zone yet. An administrator chooses it in Settings > Account, and then you can send this offer.
CONVERSA.VALIDADE_PASSADA: This time has already passed. Choose a later date.
CONVERSA.CUPOM_FALTA: Type the coupon code, with up to {n} letters and numbers, to send.
